meta.title: A document is waiting for you | Everstead

title: A document is waiting for you.
signedIn: Accept it and it goes into your own vault. It stays yours, including if you later leave the organisation that sent it.
expired: This one has expired or has already been answered. Ask whoever sent it to send it again.
safety: Everstead never attaches a file to an email, and this page never opens one until you have confirmed a code. If you were not expecting this, decline it and tell us at hello@everstead.care.
footer: Everstead, the place your family can find everything.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

code.intro: Before anything opens, we will send a six-digit code to {{hint}}, the address this was sent to. Having the link is not enough on its own.
code.sent: We have sent a code to {{hint}}. It expires in ten minutes.
code.label: Six-digit code

ready.lead: Confirmed. You can take the document now, or keep it somewhere it will still be there in ten years.
ready.keep: Keep it in a free vault
ready.note: Downloading is a perfectly good answer. A free vault just means you still have it when the laptop dies, and you can share it with whoever needs it next.

downloaded.title: Downloaded.
downloaded.body: It is yours. Nothing was stored with Everstead, and the sender can see only that it arrived.
downloaded.cta: Keep the next one in a free vault

accepted.title: It is in your vault.
accepted.body: You own this document now. Taking you to your documents.

declined.title: Declined.
declined.body: Nothing was added to your vault, and the file has been deleted.

missing.title: This link is no longer valid.
missing.body: It may have already been used, or the organisation may have withdrawn it. Ask them to send it again.
